ourBrands.title: Our brands
ourBrands.johnBean: John Bean® has been a leader in automotive equipment for garages, tire shops, and body repair services since launching the world’s first wheel aligner in 1925. John Bean has been a world-leading source for automotive undercar service equipment solutions for over 100 years and was acquired in 1996 by Snap-on Incorporated.
ourBrands.hoffman: Steeped in a legacy of innovation and excellence, Hofmann® designs wheel alignment machines that truly set industry standards. We fuse eight decades of experience with cutting-edge technology, ensuring our equipment offers time-honored reliability and forward-thinking features.

installations.title: Installations
installations.description: Our Installation service allows clients to request official installation certificates for any equipment purchased through SOE Latam, ensuring compliance and quality standards.

equipments.title: Equipments
equipments.description: Through our Equipment section, customers can explore our full catalog of cutting-edge tools and machinery tailored for professional automotive service centers.

warranties.title: Warranties
warranties.description: Our Warranty service provides a seamless process to submit warranty requests for certified and properly installed equipment, backed by Snap-on’s commitment to durability and support.

manuals.title: Manuals
manuals.description: Additionally, our Manuals section offers easy access to user guides and documentation for all installed equipment—ensuring technicians can operate with confidence and efficiency. With SOE Latam, excellence doesn't stop at purchase—it extends through every step of your workshop’s journey.

part1.title: 🛠️ About SOE Latam
part1.paragraph1: At SOE Latam, we are proud to be the official franchise partner of Snap-on, the world-renowned leader in premium automotive equipment. Our mission is to bring the same legacy of precision, performance, and innovation to workshops and service centers across Latin America.
part1.paragraph2: Backed by Snap-on’s century-long heritage of excellence, we deliver industry-leading garage equipment, including advanced wheel aligners, tire changers, lifts, diagnostic tools, and more—designed for professionals who demand nothing but the best.
part1.paragraph3: With deep roots in Latin American markets and a passion for automotive progress, we provide tailored solutions that help businesses increase efficiency, improve safety, and raise service quality to global standards.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become the most trusted and advanced provider of automotive equipment solutions across Latin America, empowering professionals with the technology and support they need to thrive in a rapidly evolving industry.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To deliver world-class Snap-on Equipment and services throughout Latin America by combining global innovation with local expertise. We aim to build lasting partnerships with our customers, grounded in reliability, performance, and continuous improvement.

bullet1.title: Global Innovation, Local Service
bullet1.description: We bring state-of-the-art technology from Snap-on’s global R&D centers directly to Latin American businesses—with local support and training every step of the way.

bullet2.title: Unmatched Product Quality
bullet2.description: From precision alignment machines to heavy-duty lifts, our equipment is engineered for durability, safety, and consistent performance in the most demanding environments.

bullet3.title: Expert Technical Support
bullet3.description: Our regional teams are factory-trained to ensure optimal installation, calibration, and after-sales assistance tailored to your needs.

bullet4.title: Customized Business Solutions
bullet4.description: We understand the diverse challenges of the Latin American market. That’s why we offer scalable packages for workshops of all sizes, from independent garages to dealership networks.

bullet5.title: Commitment to Growth & Training
bullet5.description: Our priority is not just to sell equipment but to grow with you—through ongoing education, service optimization, and next-generation technology.

acceptanceTerms.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptanceTerms.description: By accessing and using the SOE Latam platform (hereinafter referred to as "the Platform"), the user agrees to comply with these Terms and Conditions, as well as our privacy and data usage policies. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must refrain from using the Platform.

platformDescription.title: 2. Platform Description
platformDescription.description: SOE Latam is a digital tool designed to facilitate communication between users and the company's administrators for the purpose of managing the request and delivery of:

list.bullet1: Installation certificates for equipment such as wheel balancers, wheel aligners, forklifts, and other products offered by the company.
list.bullet2: Equipment warranties for installed or acquired products.
list.bullet3: User manuals and technical documentation for the equipment.

registrationAccess.title: 3. Registration and Access
registrationAccess.description: To access certain services, users must register by providing truthful, complete, and up-to-date information. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and for all activities conducted under their account.

acceptableUse.title: 4. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.description: Users agree to use the Platform legally and solely for its intended purposes. The following actions are strictly prohibited:

list.bullet1: Providing false information or impersonating third parties.
list.bullet2: Interfering with the technical functioning of the Platform.
list.bullet3: Attempting to access restricted areas or other users’ data without authorization.

issuanceCertificates.title: 5. Issuance of Certificates and Warranties
issuanceCertificates.description: The issuance of installation certificates is subject to prior validation by the company’s technical team. Certificates will be delivered digitally through the Platform. Users will also be able to consult and download equipment warranties, provided that the installation has been previously registered in accordance with the company’s procedures.

availabilityManuals.title: 6. Availability of Manuals
availabilityManuals.description: The Platform provides users with access to technical manuals for the equipment acquired. These manuals may be viewed or downloaded in digital format. These documents are protected by copyright and may not be redistributed without prior authorization.

responsibilities.title: 7. Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: The company shall not be held liable for:

list.bullet1: Errors or omissions in the information provided by users.
list.bullet2: Damages resulting from the improper use of certificates or warranties.
list.bullet3: External technical failures that temporarily hinder access to the Platform.

modifications.title: 8. Modifications
modifications.description: The company reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will be communicated via the Platform, and continued use of the Platform implies acceptance of such changes.

intellectualProperty.title: 9. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.description: All rights related to the content, design, and functionalities of the Platform are the property of the company. Any total or partial reproduction is prohibited without prior consent.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing Law
governingLaw.description: These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the country where the company’s main office is located. Any dispute will be resolved before the competent courts of that jurisdiction.
